paper_id: PhoneLM_an Efficient and Capable Small Language Model Family through Principled Pre-training
title: PhoneLM: an Efficient and Capable Small Language Model Family through Principled Pre-training
motivation: 现有SLM设计不考虑设备硬件特性，仅以参数量小作为高效依据
problem_framing: 将运行时效率设为首要设计目标，在预训练前搜索最优硬件架构
key_insight: 运行时速度对架构敏感度远高于损失，同参数模型可差3.13×速度
method_signature: 预训练前在目标硬件上穷举搜索架构超参数
evaluation_criteria: 速度-能力 tradeoff（吞吐量和7项零样本任务准确率）
evidence_for_taste: runtime speed is more sensitive to the SLM architecture than the loss
the range of its runtime speed is much wider than that of the loss
Architecture searching for (near-)optimal runtime efficiency before pre-training
the cost of pre-training SLMs for different devices will be amortized
thinking_moves: 通过实验发现速度对架构敏感度被低估
将后置优化改为前置搜索的设计范式转换
验证稀疏性和整数运算兼容性为ReLU提供硬件优势
